zh.name: 居家灯光氛围实拍
zh.summary: 用实拍展示灯光改变房间氛围。
zh.useWhen: 适合氛围灯、床头灯和需要展示光线效果的产品。
zh.instructions: 上传开灯前后的房间图和灯具照，填写卖点。

en.name: Real Home Lighting and Atmosphere
en.summary: Turn your product photos into a TikTok Shop carousel about real Home Lighting and Atmosphere.
en.useWhen: For mood lights, bedside lamps, and products with a visible lighting effect.
en.instructions: Upload product and reference photos, then add verified details.
en.output: An editable TikTok Shop carousel with real Home Lighting and Atmosphere.
